text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the metering postmortem — delayed token ingest on 2026-03-19 impacted ~142 accounts; some invoices already closed. Need owners for backfill, invoice decisions, and detection.

priya: I can own the credits/backfill run. Need the affected CSV and a decision matrix for credit vs invoice reissue. ETA for sample run: Wed 2026-03-25 AM.

tom: I'll own comms + invoice reissue policy. Suggest tiers: auto-credit for small deltas, manual review above $750. Will post draft emails by Thu AM.

maya: I'll take the ingest patch (dedupe/idempotency). Plan: canary Mon 2026-03-23, full roll Tue if green. Adding a smoke test to assert token parity on sample accounts.

billing-bot: Export ready: /exports/2026-03-21/ingest_2812345678_affected.csv (rows:142). Fields: account_id,email,delta_tokens,est_credit_usd,invoice_id,invoice_status.

alex: Action list: 1) ingest fix — maya — Mon 3/23; 2) backfill sample & reconcile — priya — Wed 3/25; 3) invoice reissue decision & comms — tom — Thu 3/26; 4) postmortem doc + timeline — alex — Mon 3/30.

priya: QA gate: sample 30 accounts across buckets before full backfill. Use idempotency tokens on credit job to avoid double-credit.

maya: Canary queued. eng-sre monitoring hooks: duplicate-event-rate, ingest-latency. eng-sre-bot will post canary status.

eng-sre-bot: Canary started: 5% traffic. Alerts: duplicate-event-rate > 0.1% for 15m.

tom: Note: prefer credits for enterprise accounts unless legal/account team asks for invoice reissue. I'll coordinate with account execs.

alex: Good. We'll reconvene after priya posts sample reconciliation. I'll add owners to the linear ticket and attach the postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
